# A checkbox's and a toggle's @change hands its handler the new state, run on
# every target a test can execute on.
#
# testdata/toggle_change_payload.txtar is the code; this is the answer. The
# test drives each control through the platform's own input path -- a key press
# on bubbletea, the widget's callback on fyne, its state set on gtk4 (which is
# what fires the signal), the element's `checked` and a dispatched change on
# html -- and the interpreter runs the checked IR, where the `:checked` binding
# is still the node's and is written back from the payload before the handler
# runs.
#
# The flips alternate from the state each control is in, because bubbletea's
# key press and android's click flip the control whatever the payload says.
#
# The canvas half is a click wired on fyne and gtk4 through a Tap and a
# GtkGestureClick; testdata/canvas_click.txtar has the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go canvas.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=none canvas.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

[gtk4] stdout 'PASS'
[gtk4] ! stdout 'FAIL'

[gtk4] sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go canvas.sngl
[gtk4] stdout 'PASS'
[gtk4] ! stdout 'FAIL'


sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=html canvas.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var on = false
    var lit = false
    var seen = "none"
    vbox {
        checkbox #box(:checked=on, label="a", @change(e) { seen = "box {e.checked} {on}" })
        toggle #sw(checked=lit, label="b", @change(e) {
            lit = e.checked
            seen = "sw {e.checked}"
        })
        text(value=seen)
    }
}

func testCheckboxCarriesChecked(t Test, c main) {
    c.box.change({checked=true})
    t.assert(c.seen == "box true true")
    t.assert(c.on == true)
    c.box.change({checked=false})
    t.assert(c.seen == "box false false")
    t.assert(c.on == false)
}

func testToggleCarriesChecked(t Test, c main) {
    c.sw.change({checked=true})
    t.assert(c.seen == "sw true")
    t.assert(c.lit == true)
    c.sw.change({checked=false})
    t.assert(c.seen == "sw false")
    t.assert(c.lit == false)
}

window {
    main
}
-- canvas.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        text(value="hits {hits}")
        draw.canvas #board(width=40px, height=40px, @click(e) { hits += 1 }) {
            draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=20.0, r=10.0)
        }
    }
}

func testClickCounts(t Test, c main) {
    c.board.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
    c.board.click({})
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
}

window {
    main
}
